goods_receipts_decision_recorded.name: goods_receipts_decision_recorded
goods_receipts_decision_recorded.value:
"goods_receipts"."status" = 'posted' AND "goods_receipts"."decided_by" IS NULL
        OR "goods_receipts"."status" = 'pending_approval'
        OR "goods_receipts"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "goods_receipts"."decision_reason" IS NOT NULL

inventory_movements_has_side.name: inventory_movements_has_side
inventory_movements_has_side.value:
("inventory_movements"."from_location_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_movements"."from_status" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("inventory_movements"."to_location_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_movements"."to_status" IS NOT NULL)

inventory_movements_sides_complete.name: inventory_movements_sides_complete
inventory_movements_sides_complete.value:
("inventory_movements"."from_location_id" IS NULL) = ("inventory_movements"."from_status" IS NULL)
        AND ("inventory_movements"."to_location_id" IS NULL) = ("inventory_movements"."to_status" IS NULL)

order_item_shortages_resolution_complete.name: order_item_shortages_resolution_complete
order_item_shortages_resolution_complete.value: "order_item_shortages"."status" = 'open' OR ("order_item_shortages"."resolution" IS NOT NULL AND "order_item_shortages"."resolved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "order_item_shortages"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)
